Function reference

Interactive data editor

data_edit() opens the data editor to view, enter, filter and edit data. It is also available from the RStudio Addins menu as Interactive Data Editor.

data_edit()
An interactive editor for viewing, entering and editing data

Databases

Edit tables stored in a database. Pass a dbplyr lazy table to data_edit(), or describe the table with db_table() when the key or the table to write to cannot be detected.

db_table()
Edit a table in a database

Code generation

Generate tidyverse-style code that reproduces data edits using dplyr verbs.

data_code()
Generate tidyverse code to replicate data edits

Shiny modules

Add the data editor to your own shiny applications with the dataEdit module. Save the changes (e.g. to a database) with dataEditCommit() and count unsaved changes with dataEditChanges().

dataEditUI() dataEditServer()
Shiny module for data editing
dataEditCommit() dataEditChanges()
Save the changes made in a data editor

Other shiny modules

Modules for loading, filtering, selecting, synchronising and saving data that were combined in data_edit() before DataEditR 2.0. They can be combined with the dataEdit module in your own applications.

dataInputUI() dataInputServer()
Shiny module for data input
dataFilterUI() dataFilterServer()
Shiny module for filtering data
dataSelectUI() dataSelectServer()
Shiny module for selecting data
dataSyncUI() dataSyncServer()
A shiny module to synchronise datasets
dataOutputUI() dataOutputServer()
Shiny module for data output
